# Frame Codex Weavers
#
# This file lists trusted contributors ("Weavers") who have demonstrated
# consistent high-quality contributions to the Frame Codex. PRs opened by
# users in this list are approved and labelled "landing" after passing all
# validation checks; a maintainer lands them after their review comments are
# read, answered and resolved. No workflow merges them.
#
# Format: One GitHub username per line (no @ symbol)
# Comments start with #
#
# The Trusted Weavers workflow reads this file from the base branch, so a
# name added in a pull request counts once that pull request is merged.
#
# To become a Weaver:
# 1. Submit 5+ high-quality PRs that pass all validation
# 2. Demonstrate understanding of the Codex schema and quality standards
# 3. Receive nomination from existing Weavers or maintainers
